show.description: A young woman named Bridget meets a mysterious man who claims to be Santa Claus. Bridget is struggling with her financial situation and her family's expectations, while "Mr. Santa" shows her a glimpse of a different, more magical reality. The film explores themes of finding love, destiny, and happiness even amidst life's challenges.
